name: Finnhub
label: Finnhub
description: Finnhub official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: quote, candle, company_profile, news, forex_rate. Docs: https://finnhub.io/docs/api. Finnhub terms. Exchange licences on some datasets. Token query. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Finnhub request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"quote"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: quote | candle | company_profile | news | forex_rate. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'quote'.

schema.label: base
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `base` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: from
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `from` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: resolution
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `resolution` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: symbol
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `symbol` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: to
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `to` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: date
schema.description: forex_rate historical date YYYY-MM-DD. Official date.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: quote, candle, company_profile, news, forex_rate.

configurationParameters.label: Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `query`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
